# Data

## RNA data

Import the data

```{r}
# all cells, RNA data, 3 assays: raw, normalised, batch corrected
RNA_data.path.bond = file.path("..","DataSources","HMAS_Bond","Seurat4.rds")
RNA_input_data.bond = readRDS(RNA_data.path.bond)
```

Extract SCT transformed RNA data and metadata

```{r}
# extract data objects
RNA.counts <- as.matrix(RNA_input_data.bond[['SCT']]$counts) # normalised counts
RNA.data <- as.matrix(RNA_input_data.bond[['SCT']]$data) # log(RNA.counts + 1)
RNA.scale <- RNA_input_data.bond[['SCT']]$scale.data # pearson residuals created with seurat scaling
RNA.sample.metadata <- RNA_input_data.bond[[]]

# check dimensions
dim(RNA.counts)
dim(RNA.data)
dim(RNA.scale)
dim(RNA.sample.metadata)
```


Filter based on treatment type

```{r}

RNA.sample.metadata <- RNA.sample.metadata[is.element(RNA.sample.metadata$Treatment,treatments_incl),]

table(RNA.sample.metadata$Treatment, RNA.sample.metadata$Batch)

RNA.counts <- RNA.counts[,rownames(RNA.sample.metadata)]
RNA.data <- RNA.data[,rownames(RNA.sample.metadata)]
RNA.scale <- RNA.scale[,rownames(RNA.sample.metadata)]

dim(RNA.counts)
dim(RNA.data)
dim(RNA.scale)
dim(RNA.sample.metadata)
```


Filter unfiltered data based on counts per cell

```{r}
min_count <- 5
pct_cells_min_count <- 10
# features are included if there are more than pct_cells_detected% of cells with count >= min_count

# filter the counts assay
genes_incl <- (rowMeans(RNA.counts >= min_count) * 100) >= pct_cells_min_count
RNA.counts <- RNA.counts[genes_incl,]
# filter the data assay
RNA.data <- RNA.data[rownames(RNA.counts),]

dim(RNA.counts)
dim(RNA.data)
```

Select assay to use and remove data

```{r}
RNA.exp <- RNA.data
RNA.all.names <- rownames(RNA.exp)
rm(list=c("RNA_input_data.bond", "RNA.counts", "RNA.data", "RNA.scale", "genes_incl"))
gc()
```


Filter out transcripts without an ensembl id

```{r}
genes_incl <- substr(rownames(RNA.exp),1,4)=="ENSG"
RNA.exp <- RNA.exp[genes_incl,]
RNA.all.names <- RNA.all.names[genes_incl]
```


## Combine RNA with non-RNA data

Load non-rna data from Bond article

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# all cells, non-rna assays
data.path.bond <- file.path("..","DataSources","HMAS_Bond","NOMeSeq_MAE_upd.rds")
input_data.bond <- readRDS(data.path.bond)
# check the assay names
names(assays(input_data.bond))
gc()
```

Load the non-rna metadata

```{r}
nonrna.metadata.path <- file.path("..","DataSources","HMAS_Bond","NOMeSeq_MAE_upd_rowRanges_Key.txt")
nonrna.metadata <- read.delim(nonrna.metadata.path,header = TRUE)
gc()
```


Extract the sample metadata

```{r}
MetAcc.sample.metadata <- as.data.frame(colData(input_data.bond))
table(MetAcc.sample.metadata$Treatment, MetAcc.sample.metadata$Batch)
```

Align sample ids between rna and non-rna assays

```{r}
RNA.sample.metadata$Well_v2 <- RNA.sample.metadata$Well

# fix up Well symbol so it is format 'A01'
num_1 <- substr(RNA.sample.metadata$Well_v2,1,1) < "99"
num_2 <- substr(RNA.sample.metadata$Well_v2,2,2) < "99"
nchar_2 <- nchar(RNA.sample.metadata$Well_v2)==2

RNA.sample.metadata$Well_v2[num_1 & num_2] <- paste0(
  substr(RNA.sample.metadata$Well_v2[num_1 & num_2],3,3),
  substr(RNA.sample.metadata$Well_v2[num_1 & num_2],1,2)
)

RNA.sample.metadata$Well_v2[num_1 & nchar_2] <- paste0(
  substr(RNA.sample.metadata$Well_v2[num_1 & nchar_2],2,2),
  "0",
  substr(RNA.sample.metadata$Well_v2[num_1 & nchar_2],1,1)
)

# create new sample ids
RNA.sample.metadata$Sample_v2 <- paste0(
  RNA.sample.metadata$Treatment,
  ".",
  RNA.sample.metadata$Batch,
  ".",
  RNA.sample.metadata$Well_v2
)

# check alignment with the nonRNA data
mean(is.element(RNA.sample.metadata$Sample_v2, rownames(MetAcc.sample.metadata)))

# change sample names
mean(rownames(RNA.sample.metadata)==colnames(RNA.exp))
rownames(RNA.sample.metadata) <- RNA.sample.metadata$Sample_v2
colnames(RNA.exp) <- RNA.sample.metadata$Sample_v2

# change order of the nonRNA sample metadata
MetAcc.sample.metadata <- MetAcc.sample.metadata[rownames(RNA.sample.metadata),]

```

Add the rna assay

```{r}
input_data.bond@ExperimentList@listData$rna <- RNA.exp
rm(list=c("RNA.exp"))
gc()
```


Check dims

```{r}
lapply(input_data.bond@ExperimentList@listData, function(block){
  dim(block)
})
gc()
```

## Select and filter assays

Select and filter blocks to use for the analysis.
In the paper they mention cpg islands and 3kb windows as locations on the genome where
epigentic features are significantly correlated with selected genes.
Focussing on cpg islands here.

```{r}
assay.names = c("acc_CGI", "met_CGI", "rna")

pct_cells_detected = 60 
# features are included if there are more than pct_cells_detected% of cells without NA
n_hvrs = 5000 
# if n_hvrs>0 then the n_hvrs most variable features are selected for each block
fit_data <- sapply(assay.names, function(assay.name){
  input_data.bond[[assay.name]]
}, simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
# remove uneeded data
rm(list=c("input_data.bond"))
gc()
# transform the data if necessary
fit_data <- lapply(fit_data, function(x) {
      exp <- x
      if (is(exp, "SummarizedExperiment"))
      {
        exp <- as.matrix(assay(exp, 1))
      }
      # mat <- as.matrix(t(exp))
      exp <- exp[,rownames(RNA.sample.metadata)]
      mat <- t(exp)
    }) 
gc()
# filter out features with too many NA values
fit_data <- lapply(fit_data, function(x) {
      keep <- colSums(!is.na(x))/nrow(x)*100 >= pct_cells_detected
      x[,keep]
    })
# filter out features with no/low variance
fit_data <- lapply(fit_data, function(x) {
      mat <- x
      if (n_hvrs > 0 && dim(mat)[2] > n_hvrs)
      {
        hvrs <- rank(-colVars(mat, na.rm = TRUE)) <= n_hvrs
        mat <- mat[,hvrs]
      } else
      {
        mat
      }
    })
gc()
# names(fit_data) = assay.names

# filter non-rna metadata file
nonrna.metadata <- nonrna.metadata[is.element(nonrna.metadata$context,assay.names),]
gc()
```


Checks

```{r}
# missingness
lapply(fit_data, function(block){
  mean(is.na(block))
})
# dimensions
lapply(fit_data, function(block){
  dim(block)
})
# alignment of names
lapply(fit_data, function(block){
  mean(rownames(block) == rownames(RNA.sample.metadata))
})
```


Extract study and response variables

```{r}
sample.study <- as.character(RNA.sample.metadata$Batch)
studies <- unique(sample.study)
sample.response <- RNA.sample.metadata$Treatment
response_names <- unique(sample.response)
table(sample.response, sample.study)
```


exclude any features with no variance in a particular study

```{r}
fit_data <- lapply(fit_data, function(block){
  feature_vars_study <- sapply(studies, function(study_name){
      # incl <- RNA.sample.metadata$Batch == study_name
      incl <- sample.study == study_name
      block_incl <- block[incl,]
      feature_vars_study <- apply(block_incl,2,var,na.rm=TRUE)
      feature_vars_study[is.na(feature_vars_study)] <- 0
      return(feature_vars_study)
  }, simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
  feature_vars_block <- do.call(rbind,feature_vars_study)
  feature_vars_block <- feature_vars_block > 0
  feature_vars_block <- apply(feature_vars_block,2,mean) == 1
  block[,feature_vars_block]
})
gc()
```


(re)check dims and variances

```{r}
# recheck dims
lapply(fit_data, function(block){
  dim(block)
})
# check the proportion of samples and features with variance > 0
lapply(fit_data, function(block){
  sapply(studies, function(study_name){
      incl <- sample.study == study_name
      block_incl <- block[incl,]
      sample_vars <- apply(block_incl,1,var,na.rm=TRUE)
      feature_vars <- apply(block_incl,2,var,na.rm=TRUE)
      all_vars <- list(
        sample_vars = sum(sample_vars > 0,na.rm = TRUE)/length(sample_vars),
        feature_vars = sum(feature_vars > 0,na.rm = TRUE)/length(feature_vars)
      )
  }, simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
})
gc()
```

## Tidy up variable names and feature metadata

Convert variable names to character for met and acc data

```{r}
fit_data <- sapply(names(fit_data), function(block){
  if (block != 'rna'){
    colnames(fit_data[[block]]) <- paste0(block,"_",colnames(fit_data[[block]]))
    }
  return(fit_data[[block]])
  },simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
```

Create list with feature metadata

```{r}
# create list with non-rna metadata
feature.metadata <- split(nonrna.metadata, nonrna.metadata$context)
# filter and order non-rna metadata
feature.metadata <- sapply(names(feature.metadata),function(block){
  rownames(feature.metadata[[block]]) <- paste0(block,"_",feature.metadata[[block]]$context_ID)
  feature.metadata[[block]] <- feature.metadata[[block]][colnames(fit_data[[block]]),]
},simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)

# add in rna
feature.metadata[['rna']] <- data.frame(
  ensembl_ID = colnames(fit_data$rna)
)
rownames(feature.metadata[['rna']]) <- feature.metadata[['rna']]$ensembl_ID
# 
```

Extract all ensembl IDs and find gene IDs

```{r}
# create vector of enseml ids
ensembl_ids <- lapply(feature.metadata,function(block){
  block$ensembl_ID
})

ensembl_ids <- unique(as.vector(unlist(ensembl_ids)))
ensembl_ids <- ensembl_ids[ensembl_ids!=""]

# use bioMart to match ensemble ids to gene names
mart <- useMart(biomart = "ENSEMBL_MART_ENSEMBL", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

gene_info <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol"),
  filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
  values = ensembl_ids,
  mart = mart
) 

colnames(gene_info)[1] <- "ensembl_ID"

# add gene names to metadata
feature.metadata <- lapply(feature.metadata, function(block){
  block %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "row_id") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_info, by = "ensembl_ID") %>% 
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "row_id") %>%
  as.data.frame()
})
```

Create new variable names

```{r}
# create new variable with either hgnc id, or ensembl id if no hgnc id
feature.metadata <- lapply(feature.metadata, function(block){
  block$gene_id <- block$hgnc_symbol
  block$gene_id[is.na(block$gene_id)|block$gene_id==""] <- block$ensembl_ID[is.na(block$gene_id)|block$gene_id==""]
  return(block)
})

# change names for RNA variables
rownames(feature.metadata$rna) <- feature.metadata$rna$gene_id
colnames(fit_data$rna) <- rownames(feature.metadata$rna)

# create new variable with extended names for acc and meth
feature.metadata <- sapply(names(feature.metadata), function(block){
  block.dat <- feature.metadata[[block]]
  if (block != 'rna'){
  block.dat$med_name <- paste0(
    substr(rownames(block.dat),1,3),
    "; chr_", block.dat$chr, "_", block.dat$start, ":", block.dat$end,
    "; gene_", block.dat$gene_id
  )
  block.dat$long_name <- paste0(
    rownames(block.dat),
    "; chr_", block.dat$chr, "_", block.dat$start, ":", block.dat$end,
    "; gene_", block.dat$gene_id
  )
  }
  return(block.dat)
},simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)

# export the metadata list in case needed
saveRDS(object = feature.metadata, file = file.path(plot_folder, 'feature.metadata.rds'))
```


Create concatenated feature metadata data frame for renaming variables when necessary

```{r}
feature.metadata.df <- sapply(names(feature.metadata),function(block){
  block.dat <- feature.metadata[[block]]
  if (block != 'rna'){
    new.block.dat <- data.frame(
      med_name = block.dat$med_name,
      long_name = block.dat$long_name
    )
  } else {
    new.block.dat <- data.frame(
      med_name = rownames(block.dat),
      long_name = rownames(block.dat)
    )
  }
  rownames(new.block.dat) <- rownames(block.dat)
  return(new.block.dat)
},simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = FALSE)

feature.metadata.df <- do.call(rbind,feature.metadata.df)
# export the metadata df in case needed
saveRDS(object = feature.metadata.df, file = file.path(plot_folder, 'feature.metadata.df.rds'))
```


## Unwanted variation adjusment

ComBat adjusted data

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# specify a model based on the response that will be used?
mod <- model.matrix(~as.factor(sample.response))

fit_data.combat <- lapply(fit_data, function(x){
   t(ComBat(t(x), batch = sample.study, mod=mod))
})

```

RBE adjusted data

```{r}
fit_data.RBE <- lapply(fit_data, function(x){
   t(removeBatchEffect(t(x), batch = sample.study, design=mod))
})
```

Export uncorrected and ComBat corrected data in case needed

```{r}
saveRDS(object = fit_data, file = file.path(plot_folder, 'fit_data.rds'))
saveRDS(object = fit_data.combat, file = file.path(plot_folder, 'fit_data.combat.rds'))
```


## Unwanted variation in raw data

Get PCs for each block

```{r}
fit.pca <- lapply(names(fit_data), function(block){
    PCA <- mixOmics::pca(X = fit_data[[block]], ncomp = 2, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)$variates$X
    PCA <- as.data.frame(scale(PCA))
    PCA$block <- block
    PCA$Class <- as.factor(sample.response)
    PCA$Batch <- as.factor(sample.study)
    return(PCA)
})

fit.pca <- do.call(rbind,fit.pca)
```


Plot to examine variation

```{r}
ggplot(fit.pca, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Batch)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_grid(~block) +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major=element_blank()
    , strip.text = element_text(size = 16)
    , axis.title = element_text(size = 14)
    # , axis.text = element_text(size = 14)
    , axis.text = element_blank()
    , axis.ticks = element_blank()
    , legend.title = element_text(size = 14)
    , legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
    # ,legend.position="none"
    ) +
  # scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")
  scale_color_manual(values = my_Set1)

ggsave(file.path(plot_folder,'PCA.pdf'), width = 20, height = 10, units = "cm") 
ggsave(file.path(plot_folder,'PCA.png'), width = 20, height = 10, units = "cm") 
```


# Benchmarking with all data

## Choose inputs

For benchmarking we use 1 component.
They used 2 in the article but tuning showed that 1 is enough and with 2 the performance declines

```{r}
ncomp <- 1
keepX <- list(acc_CGI = c(50), met_CGI = c(50), rna = c(50))
# retain benchmarking params in case used later
ncomp.benchmarking <- ncomp
keepX.benchmarking <- keepX
```


## Fit using all data

```{r}
# splsda no correction
fit.block.splsda.full <- block.splsda(X = fit_data, Y = sample.response, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX)
# splsda, combat corrected
fit.block.splsda.combat.full <- block.splsda(X = fit_data.combat, Y = sample.response, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX)
# splsda, RBA corrected
fit.block.splsda.RBE.full <- block.splsda(X = fit_data.RBE, Y = sample.response, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX)
# mint block
fit.mint.block.splsda.full <- mint.block.splsda(X = fit_data, Y = sample.response, study=sample.study, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX)
```


## Quantitative measures of spread

```{r}
fits <- list(

)
```

# Benchmark using subsets

## Fit models

block.splsda on raw data

```{r}
fit.block.splsda <- sapply(studies, function(x){
  InTrain <- !is.element(sample.study,x)
  Y.train <- sample.response[InTrain]
  fit_data.train <- lapply(fit_data, function(y){y[InTrain,]})
  fit <- block.splsda(X = fit_data.train, Y = Y.train, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX)
}, simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
```

block.splsda on combat adjusted data (each training dataset adjusted independently)

```{r, message=FALSE}
fit.block.splsda.combat <- sapply(studies, function(x){
  InTrain <- !is.element(sample.study,x)
  Y.train <- sample.response[InTrain]
  fit_data.train = lapply(fit_data, function(y){
      t(ComBat(t(y[InTrain,]), batch = sample.study[InTrain], mod = model.matrix(~as.factor(Y.train))))
      })
  fit <- block.splsda(X = fit_data.train, Y = Y.train, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX)
}, simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
```

block.splsda on RBE adjusted data (each training dataset adjusted independently)

```{r, message=FALSE}
fit.block.splsda.RBE <- sapply(studies, function(x){
  InTrain <- !is.element(sample.study,x)
  Y.train <- sample.response[InTrain]
  fit_data.train <- lapply(fit_data, function(y){
      t(removeBatchEffect(t(y[InTrain,]), batch = sample.study[InTrain], design = model.matrix(~as.factor(Y.train))))
      })
  fit <- block.splsda(X = fit_data.train, Y = Y.train, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX)
}, simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
```

mint.block.splsda fit

```{r}
fit.mint.block.splsda <- sapply(studies, function(x){
  InTrain <- !is.element(sample.study,x)
  Y.train <- sample.response[InTrain]
  fit_data.train <- lapply(fit_data, function(y){y[InTrain,]})
  sample.study.train <- sample.study[InTrain]
  fit <- mint.block.splsda(X = fit_data.train, Y = Y.train, study = sample.study.train, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX)
}, simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
```


## Extract features and compare stability across subsets

Extract and plot for all fits

```{r}
fits <- list(
  "DIABLO" = fit.block.splsda,
  "DIABLO_combat" = fit.block.splsda.combat,
  "DIABLO_rbe" = fit.block.splsda.RBE,
  "MINT Block" = fit.mint.block.splsda
)

#####
# stability using all components
####

selection_frequency_th <- length(fits[[1]]) * (1/2)
# features selected in > selection_frequency_th studies put in the 'more' group

fit.feature.props <- extract.fit.feature.props(
  fits = fits, 
  blocks = names(fit_data), 
  selection_frequency_th = selection_frequency_th,
  begin_comp = 1,
  end_comp = ncomp
  )

# plot the feature selection proportions by fit and block and frequency
ggplot(fit.feature.props) + 
  geom_col(aes(x = selection_frequency, y = proportion_of_features, fill = fit), position = 'dodge') + 
  labs(
    x = "Selection frequency",
    y = "Proportion of variables"
    ) +
  facet_grid(~block) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    # axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),

    ) +

ggsave(file.path(plot_folder,'stability_all.png'), width = 20, height = 10, units = "cm") 

# print proportion of features selected across all fits

print(fit.feature.props)

# print proportions by frequency group

fit.feature.props.group <- fit.feature.props %>%
  group_by(block, fit, selection_frequency_group) %>%
  summarise(proportion = sum(proportion_of_features)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
fit.feature.props.group$proportion <- round(fit.feature.props.group$proportion,2)

print(fit.feature.props.group)

# print stability score by block and model
# ave_freq = sum(wghtd_freq)
# wghtd_freq = freq * (proportion of selected features selected with that freq)

fit.feature.props.global <- fit.feature.props %>%
  group_by(block, fit) %>%
  summarise(ave_freq = sum(wghtd_freq)) %>%  
  as.data.frame()
fit.feature.props.global$stability <- round(fit.feature.props.global$ave_freq / length(studies),2)
fit.feature.props.global$ave_freq <- round(fit.feature.props.global$ave_freq,2)

print(fit.feature.props.global)
```

## Make predictions for held out studies


predict using block.splsda model

```{r}
pred.block.splsda <- sapply(studies, function(x){
  InTest <- is.element(sample.study,x)
  pred_data.test <- lapply(fit_data, function(y){y[InTest,]})
  pred <- predict(object = fit.block.splsda[[x]], newdata = pred_data.test)
  Y.test <- sample.response[InTest]
  pred.actual <- list(
    pred = pred,
    Y.test = Y.test
  )
}, simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
```

predict using block.splsda.combat model

```{r}
pred.block.splsda.combat <- sapply(studies, function(x){
  InTest <- is.element(sample.study,x)
  pred_data.test <- lapply(fit_data, function(y){y[InTest,]})
  pred <- predict(object = fit.block.splsda.combat[[x]], newdata = pred_data.test)
  Y.test <- sample.response[InTest]
  pred.actual <- list(
    pred = pred,
    Y.test = Y.test
  )
}, simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
```

predict using block.splsda.RBE model

```{r}
pred.block.splsda.RBE <- sapply(studies, function(x){
  InTest <- is.element(sample.study,x)
  pred_data.test <- lapply(fit_data, function(y){y[InTest,]})
  pred <- predict(object = fit.block.splsda.RBE[[x]], newdata = pred_data.test)
  Y.test <- sample.response[InTest]
  pred.actual <- list(
    pred = pred,
    Y.test = Y.test
  )
}, simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
```

predict using mint.block.splsda model

```{r}
pred.mint.block.splsda <- sapply(studies, function(x){
  InTest <- is.element(sample.study,x)
  pred_data.test <- lapply(fit_data, function(y){y[InTest,]})
  sample.study.test <- sample.study[InTest]
  pred <- predict(object = fit.mint.block.splsda[[x]], newdata = pred_data.test, study.test = sample.study.test)
  Y.test <- sample.response[InTest]
  pred.actual <- list(
    pred = pred,
    Y.test = Y.test
  )
}, simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
```


## Compare predictions

choose evaluation metrics

```{r}
prediction.distance <- c("max.dist", "centroids.dist", "mahalanobis.dist")[1]
prediction.type <- c("AveragedPredict.class", "WeightedPredict.class", "MajorityVote", "WeightedVote")[4]
error.type <- c("BER","ER")[1]
```

extract predictions and actuals

```{r}
predictions <- list(
  "DIABLO" = pred.block.splsda,
  "DIABLO_combat" = pred.block.splsda.combat,
  "DIABLO_rbe" = pred.block.splsda.RBE,
  "MINT Block" = pred.mint.block.splsda
)

classifications.all.models <- extract.classifications(
  predictions = predictions,
  pred.method = prediction.type,
  pred.distance = prediction.distance
  )

classifications.all.models$IfError <- !classifications.all.models$IfCorrect

```

calculate errors

```{r, message=FALSE}

# BER by model and study
classifications.BER.study <- classifications.all.models %>%
  group_by(model.name, study.name, study.actuals) %>%
  summarize(
    ErrorRate = round(mean(IfError),2)
    ) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  group_by(model.name, study.name) %>%
  summarize(
    BER = round(mean(ErrorRate),2)
    ) %>%
  as.data.frame()
classifications.BER.study

# balanced error rate
classifications.BER <- classifications.all.models %>%
  group_by(model.name, study.name, study.actuals) %>%
  summarize(
    ErrorRate = mean(IfError)
    ) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  group_by(model.name, study.name) %>%
  summarize(
    BER = mean(ErrorRate)
    ) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  group_by(model.name) %>%
  summarize(
    BER.mean = round(mean(BER),2),
    BER.sd = sd(BER),
    # BER.n = n(),
    BER.se = round(sd(BER)/sqrt(n()),3)
    ) %>%
  # mutate(BER.se = round(BER.sd/sqrt(BER.n),3)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# print errors
classifications.BER

```

### Heatmaps for selected features

create the data by component

```{r}
# show all variables
ndisplay <- max(unlist(keepX))

acc_CGI_select_comp <- vector("list")
met_CGI_select_comp <- vector("list")
rna_select_comp <- vector("list")
X_select_comp <- vector("list")
annot_colors_comp <- vector("list")
samples_annotation_comp <- vector("list")
samples_gaps_comp <- vector("list")
features_annotation_comp <- vector("list")
features_gaps_comp <- vector("list")

for (comp_to_plot in 1:ncomp){
  
  # select features form each block
  acc_CGI_rank <- rank(-abs(fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$acc_CGI[,comp_to_plot]))
  acc_CGI_select <- (fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$acc_CGI[,comp_to_plot]!=0) & (acc_CGI_rank <= ndisplay) 
  
  met_CGI_rank <- rank(-abs(fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$met_CGI[,comp_to_plot]))
  met_CGI_select <- (fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$met_CGI[,comp_to_plot]!=0) & (met_CGI_rank <= ndisplay)
  
  rna_rank <- rank(-abs(fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$rna[,comp_to_plot]))
  rna_select <- (fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$rna[,comp_to_plot]!=0) & (rna_rank <= ndisplay)
  
  
  # loadings to select
  acc_CGI_loadings_select <- fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$acc_CGI[acc_CGI_select,comp_to_plot]
  met_CGI_loadings_select <- fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$met_CGI[met_CGI_select,comp_to_plot]
  rna_loadings_select <- fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$rna[rna_select,comp_to_plot]
  loadings_select <- c(acc_CGI_loadings_select, met_CGI_loadings_select, rna_loadings_select)
  
  # observed data (scaled by study)
  X_select <- cbind(
    fit.mint.block.splsda.full$X$acc_CGI[,acc_CGI_select],
    fit.mint.block.splsda.full$X$met_CGI[,met_CGI_select],
    fit.mint.block.splsda.full$X$rna[,rna_select]
  )
  
  # annotate features
  features_annotation <- data.frame(
    Block = as.factor(c(
      rep('acc_CGI',sum(acc_CGI_select)),
      rep('met_CGI',sum(met_CGI_select)),
      rep('rna',sum(rna_select))
    ))
  )
  
  rownames(features_annotation) <- colnames(X_select)
  
  # reorder features based on block and loading
  feature_order <- order(features_annotation$Block, loadings_select)
  features_annotation <- features_annotation[feature_order,,drop=FALSE]
  X_select <- X_select[,feature_order]
  mean(colnames(X_select)==rownames(features_annotation))
  
  # set the cut points based on the grouping
  features_gaps <- integer()
  for (i in 2:length(features_annotation$Block)){
    if(features_annotation$Block[i]!=features_annotation$Block[i-1]){
      features_gaps <- c(features_gaps,i)
    }
  }
  
  # annotate samples
  samples_annotation <- data.frame(
    Batch = fit.mint.block.splsda.full$study,
    Class = fit.mint.block.splsda.full$Y
  )
  rownames(samples_annotation) <- rownames(X_select)
  sample_order <- order(samples_annotation$Class, samples_annotation$Batch)
  
  # reorder the samples based on grouping
  samples_annotation <- samples_annotation[sample_order,]
  X_select <- X_select[sample_order,]
  mean(rownames(X_select)==rownames(samples_annotation))
  # set the cut points based on the grouping
  samples_gaps <- integer()
  for (i in 2:length(samples_annotation$Class)){
    if(samples_annotation$Class[i]!=samples_annotation$Class[i-1]){
      samples_gaps <- c(samples_gaps,i)
    }
  }
  
  # set colours for annotations
  annot_colors <- list(
    Block = my_Paired[c(11,10,4)],
    Batch = my_Set1[1:nlevels(samples_annotation$Batch)], 
    Class = brewer.pal(5, "Set1")[c(2,5)]
    )
  
  names(annot_colors$Block) <- levels(features_annotation$Block)
  names(annot_colors$Batch) <- levels(samples_annotation$Batch)
  names(annot_colors$Class) <- levels(samples_annotation$Class)
  
  # save for the component
  acc_CGI_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- acc_CGI_select
  met_CGI_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- met_CGI_select
  rna_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- rna_select
  X_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- X_select
  annot_colors_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- annot_colors
  samples_annotation_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- samples_annotation
  samples_gaps_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- samples_gaps
  features_annotation_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- features_annotation
  features_gaps_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- features_gaps
  
}
```

extract the correlation matrices and plot block vs block correlations with a heatmap for each component

```{r}
# create a list to store results
cors_list <- vector("list")
cors_to_plot <- c("M_acc_CGI_met_CGI", "M_acc_CGI_rna", "M_met_CGI_rna")

for (cor_to_plot in cors_to_plot){
  for (comp_to_plot in 1:ncomp){
    
    cor_Mat <- fit.network.all[[cor_to_plot]]
    #remove rownames suffix
    rownames(cor_Mat) <- substr(rownames(cor_Mat),1,as.vector(regexpr(paste(c('_acc','_met','_rna'),collapse = "|"),rownames(cor_Mat)))-1)
    colnames(cor_Mat) <- substr(colnames(cor_Mat),1,as.vector(regexpr(paste(c('_acc','_met','_rna'),collapse = "|"),colnames(cor_Mat)))-1)
    # save all correlations before filtering
    cor_Mat_all <- cor_Mat
    # filter to include those for the component
    cor_Mat <- cor_Mat[is.element(
      rownames(cor_Mat),
      c(
        names(acc_CGI_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]])[acc_CGI_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]]],
        names(met_CGI_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]])[met_CGI_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]]],
        names(rna_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]])[rna_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]]]
      )
      ),]
    cor_Mat <- cor_Mat[,is.element(
      colnames(cor_Mat),
      c(
        names(acc_CGI_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]])[acc_CGI_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]]],
        names(met_CGI_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]])[met_CGI_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]]],
        names(rna_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]])[rna_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]]]
      )
      )]
    
    # change variable names to something more descriptive
    rownames(cor_Mat_all) <- feature.metadata.df[rownames(cor_Mat_all),]$long_name
    colnames(cor_Mat_all) <- feature.metadata.df[colnames(cor_Mat_all),]$long_name
    
    rownames(cor_Mat) <- feature.metadata.df[rownames(cor_Mat),]$long_name
    colnames(cor_Mat) <- feature.metadata.df[colnames(cor_Mat),]$long_name
    
    # save long format of cor matrices as list
    cor_Mat_all_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_Mat_all))
    colnames(cor_Mat_all_long) <- c("Block1","Block2","Correlation")
    
    cor_Mat_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_Mat))
    colnames(cor_Mat_long) <- c("Block1","Block2","Correlation")
    
    cors_list[[paste0(cor_to_plot,"_all_comps")]] <- cor_Mat_all_long
    cors_list[[paste0(cor_to_plot,"_comp_",comp_to_plot)]] <- cor_Mat_long
    
    # write.csv(x = cor_Mat_long, 
    #           file = file.path(plot_folder,paste0("heatmap_cor_",cor_to_plot,"_comp_",comp_to_plot,".csv")), 
    #           row.names = FALSE)
    
    
    # plot
      
    hm_cor <- pheatmap(
        mat = cor_Mat,
        # scale = "none",
        border_color = NA,
        cellwidth = 20,
        cellheight = 20,
        fontsize = 12,
        angle_col = 45,
        cluster_rows = TRUE,
        cluster_cols = TRUE,
        show_rownames = TRUE,
        show_colnames = TRUE,
        treeheight_row = 0,
        treeheight_col = 0
      )
    
    ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_folder,paste0("heatmap_cor_",cor_to_plot,"_comp_",comp_to_plot,".pdf")), 
           plot = hm_cor[[4]],
           width = 90, height = 80, units = "cm")
    ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_folder,paste0("heatmap_cor_",cor_to_plot,"_comp_",comp_to_plot,".png")), 
           plot = hm_cor[[4]],
           width = 90, height = 80, units = "cm")
  
  }
}

saveRDS(object = cors_list, file = file.path(plot_folder,'cors_list.rds'))
```

### Boxplots for selected features

do it by component

```{r}
ndisplay <- 10
X_acc_CGI_select_comp <- vector("list")
X_met_CGI_select_comp <- vector("list")
X_rna_select_comp <- vector("list")

for (comp_to_plot in 1:ncomp){

  # select features form each block
  acc_CGI_rank <- rank(-abs(fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$acc_CGI[,comp_to_plot]))
  acc_CGI_select <- (fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$acc_CGI[,comp_to_plot]!=0) & (acc_CGI_rank <= ndisplay)
  
  met_CGI_rank <- rank(-abs(fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$met_CGI[,comp_to_plot]))
  met_CGI_select <- (fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$met_CGI[,comp_to_plot]!=0) & (met_CGI_rank <= ndisplay)
  
  rna_rank <- rank(-abs(fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$rna[,comp_to_plot]))
  rna_select <- (fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$rna[,comp_to_plot]!=0) & (rna_rank <= ndisplay)


  # sample annotation
  samples_annotation <- data.frame(
    Sample_id = rownames(fit.mint.block.splsda.full$X$acc_CGI),
    Batch = fit.mint.block.splsda.full$study,
    Class = fit.mint.block.splsda.full$Y
  )

  # observed data (scaled by study)
  X_acc_CGI_select <- as.data.frame(fit.mint.block.splsda.full$X$acc_CGI[,acc_CGI_select])
  X_met_CGI_select <- as.data.frame(fit.mint.block.splsda.full$X$met_CGI[,met_CGI_select])
  X_rna_select <- as.data.frame(fit.mint.block.splsda.full$X$rna[,rna_select])

  # merge observed data with sample annoations
  X_acc_CGI_select <- cbind(samples_annotation,  X_acc_CGI_select)
  X_met_CGI_select <- cbind(samples_annotation,  X_met_CGI_select)
  X_rna_select <- cbind(samples_annotation,  X_rna_select)

  #reshape to long format
  X_acc_CGI_select <- reshape(
    data = X_acc_CGI_select,
    direction = "long",
    idvar = c("Sample_id", "Batch", "Class"),
    varying = list(colnames(X_acc_CGI_select)[-c(1:3)]),
    v.names = "Value",
    timevar = "Feature",
    times = colnames(X_acc_CGI_select)[-c(1:3)]
  )

  X_met_CGI_select <- reshape(
    data = X_met_CGI_select,
    direction = "long",
    idvar = c("Sample_id", "Batch", "Class"),
    varying = list(colnames(X_met_CGI_select)[-c(1:3)]),
    v.names = "Value",
    timevar = "Feature",
    times = colnames(X_met_CGI_select)[-c(1:3)]
  )
  
   X_rna_select <- reshape(
    data = X_rna_select,
    direction = "long",
    idvar = c("Sample_id", "Batch", "Class"),
    varying = list(colnames(X_rna_select)[-c(1:3)]),
    v.names = "Value",
    timevar = "Feature",
    times = colnames(X_rna_select)[-c(1:3)]
  )

  # save
  X_acc_CGI_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- X_acc_CGI_select
  X_met_CGI_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- X_met_CGI_select
  X_rna_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- X_rna_select

}
```

### ORA for processes and pathways

comp 1

```{r}
# either for a single component or by all components
comp_to_plot <- c(1)
ndisplay <- 10
# background and foreground genes
# use the original ensemble ids
background_genes <- feature.metadata$rna$ensembl_ID
foreground_genes <- feature.metadata$rna$ensembl_ID[rowSums(fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$rna[,comp_to_plot,drop=FALSE]!=0)>0]

# genesets to test

# view possible collections
collections <- msigdbr_collections(db_species = "HS")

# select genesets
gene_sets <- msigdbr(
  db_species = "HS",
  species = "human",
  subcollection = "GO:BP"
)

# extract data needed for ORA
gene_sets <- gene_sets %>% 
  dplyr::distinct(gs_name, ensembl_gene) %>% 
  as.data.frame()

# perform ORA using enrichr
ora <- enricher(
  gene = foreground_genes,
  universe = background_genes,
  minGSSize = 5,
  maxGSSize = 250,
  TERM2GENE = gene_sets
  )

ora_results <- ora@result[order(ora@result$qvalue),]
print(table(round(ora_results$qvalue,2)))


#######
# get results at specified significance level
#######

qvalue_cutoff <- 1
pvalue_cutoff <- 0.01
ora_results_sig.df <- ora_results[(ora_results$qvalue<=qvalue_cutoff) & (ora_results$pvalue <= pvalue_cutoff),]
ora_results_sig.df$GeneRatio2 <- ora_results_sig.df$Count / as.numeric(substr(ora_results_sig.df$GeneRatio,as.vector(regexpr("/", ora_results_sig.df$GeneRatio))+1,nchar(ora_results_sig.df$GeneRatio)))
ora_results_sig.df$Description_Short <- substr(ora_results_sig.df$Description,regexpr("_",ora_results_sig.df$Description)+1,nchar(ora_results_sig.df$Description))
ora_results_sig.df$rank <- rank(-ora_results_sig.df$Count, ties.method = "min")
ora_results_sig.df <- ora_results_sig.df[ora_results_sig.df$rank<=ndisplay,]
  
## plot using ggplot
ggplot(ora_results_sig.df, aes(x = FoldEnrichment, y = reorder(Description_Short, -FoldEnrichment), color = pvalue, size = Count)) +
  geom_point(stat = 'identity') + 
  # scale_size(range = c(4,10)) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red") +
  labs(x = "Fold Enrichment", y = "Geneset", color = "pvalue", size = "Gene Count") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_blank()
    # , axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10)
    , axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black")
    , axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    # , legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
    , legend.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black")
  )

ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_folder, paste0("ora_dotplot_rna_comp",paste(comp_to_plot, collapse = ""),"_qvalue",qvalue_cutoff,"_pvalue",pvalue_cutoff,".pdf")),
       width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm")
ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_folder,paste0("ora_dotplot_rna_comp",paste(comp_to_plot, collapse = ""),"_qvalue",qvalue_cutoff,"_pvalue",pvalue_cutoff,".png")),
       width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm")
```
